Fused roster count changes describe team alive totals only; they do not identify which player died, prove a trade, or establish fight quality. duration_since_present_by means the numbers_state was observed by state_present_by that many seconds before the anchor — not that the team was continuously disadvantaged for that entire interval.

Roster (ally/opponent alive count) evidence is not used for coaching: it has not passed the reliability bar. Do not state alive counts, numbers advantage or disadvantage, teammate availability, or who was last alive.
